candidate_program.name: global_completion_bound_blend
candidate_program.rationale: Ranks root-included completions using mostly greedy reward, limited optimism from cover slack, and a mean-conflict penalty. Reach is global; repeated residual greedy and cover computations are expensive, and slack need not predict final schedule quality.
candidate_program.rule: weight + residual_greedy + 0.2 * max(0, residual_cover - residual_greedy) - 0.1 * conflict_weight / (1 + degree)

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
